dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Inset: Map showing the connection between the Iowa and eastern railroads. 23 x 20 cm.
LC also has another edition by "A.M. Bailey draughtsman", 1856 which includes advertisements below inset and at left of title.
Names of railroads are listed at lower left of map.
dct_title_s: Parker's sectional & geological map of Iowa exhibiting her iron, lead, copper, coal and other geological resources and all rail roads completed in progress, and projected compiled from the U.S. surveys and personal reconnoisance. By Nathan H. Parker author of "Iowa As It Is" Clinton Io. 1856
